title: Root Orientation Calibration
negative_results: fewer than three control points is refused (underdetermined)
collinear control points are refused (rank < 3, intrinsic ambiguity)
coplanar control points are refused (rank < 3, intrinsic ambiguity)
calibrate_orientation without an OrientationProfile is refused (provenance required)

claims.statement: A Kabsch/Wahba best-fit proper rotation solved from synthetic control points recovers a planted OrientationProfile rotation exactly (POWER), up to the intrinsic ambiguity of a degenerate configuration.
The frozen calibration scores holdout control points without retuning; which OrientationProfile and version were used is recorded for provenance.
The solve uses control points only and never consults the orientation profile's rotation to choose the transform (System Contract invariant 5).

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
